exposure: History of 2 or more cesarean sections
Vaginal misoprostol administration for second-trimester termination of pregnancy
outcome: Success rate of misoprostol for pregnancy termination
Need for other auxiliary treatments in pregnancy termination
cohort: 678 women who underwent second-trimester pregnancy termination with vaginal misoprostol between 2013 and 2015
finding: Pregnancy termination using smaller divided doses of misoprostol in patients with a previous history of cesarean scarring may be associated with a lower incidence of uterine rupture.
